hero.title: Activities to book
hero.description: Experiences requiring advance booking or planning. Day-by-day details are in the itinerary.

activities.title: Daisetsuzan Ropeway
activities.description: Panoramic gondola. Opening depends on weather, can get busy in peak season.

activities.title: Ainu Village - Ikahchu Performance
activities.description: Evening Ainu dance and music show. Limited sessions, booking recommended.

activities.title: Boat trip on Lake Akan
activities.description: Lake tour with a visit to the Marimo Exhibition Center.

activities.title: Canoe on Lake Akan
activities.description: Optional. Book with local operators on arrival or in advance.

activities.title: Farm Tomita
activities.description: Lavender fields and Melon House. Free entry, check opening based on season.

activities.title: Ningle Terrace
activities.description: Artisan village in the Furano forest. Evening visit recommended, check opening hours.
